standards.title: Fit tolerance
standards.description: Mating features (lid to base, openings to components) are sized to ±0.2 mm.
standards.label: Mating features fit to ±0.2 mm

standards.title: M3 heat-set inserts
standards.description: Fasteners go into M3 heat-set brass inserts pressed into bosses.
standards.label: Fasteners go into M3 heat-set insert

standards.title: Molded ABS
standards.description: The enclosure is injection-molded ABS, so molding rules (wall, draft) apply.
standards.label: Made of molded ABS

standards.title: Minimum wall thickness
standards.description: No wall of the enclosure is thinner than 2.0 mm.
standards.label: Walls at least 2.0 mm

standards.title: Minimum draft angle
standards.description: Faces parallel to the mold pull direction have at least 1° of draft.
standards.label: Draft at least 1.0° along the mold pull

standards.title: Fit to the object
standards.description: A part made to fit an object (a stand, a cover, a mount) takes up none of the object's volume and comes within 1.0 mm of it, so the object sits in it without play.
standards.label: Takes up none of the object and comes within 1.0 mm of it

standards.title: Minimum clearance to components
standards.description: The enclosure stays at least 0.5 mm away from every board component.
standards.label: At least 0.5 mm from every board component
